stories.headline: TRAI Backs Direct-To-Device Satellite Connectivity, Proposes New Authorisation Framework
stories.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has recommended a new authorisation framework specifically for satellite network providers. The proposed regulations aim to facilitate direct-to-device satellite connectivity, allowing standard mobile phones to connect directly to satellite networks.

stories.headline: X Says Delhi Police Takedown Notices Against IFF, SFLC Were Fake
stories.summary: Social media platform X informed the Delhi High Court that takedown notices purportedly issued by the Delhi Police against digital rights organizations Internet Freedom Foundation and Software Freedom Law Centre were fake. The platform confirmed the fraudulent nature of the requests after the affected organizations challenged the account restrictions in court.

stories.headline: Global tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to AI slowdown fears
stories.summary: Major tech stocks suffered a sharp sell-off following the US midterm elections, wiping out an estimated $2.5 trillion in market value from the Nasdaq index. The market decline was driven by investor concerns over potential regulatory scrutiny of AI data center construction and broader uncertainty around AI infrastructure returns. Major technology and semiconductor firms, including Nvidia, AMD, Micron, SpaceX, and Tesla, experienced significant share price drops during the sell-off.

stories.headline: At least 10 local governments have moved to drop Flock’s surveillance cameras since summer
stories.summary: At least 10 local governments and police departments in the United States have moved to restrict or terminate their use of Flock Safety technology since this summer. The decisions reflect growing public pushback and concerns over data privacy, mass surveillance, and data-sharing practices related to the company's automated license plate readers and edge-computing devices.

stories.headline: Safari's Autofill feature may be distorting time
stories.summary: A persistent bug in Apple's Safari browser reportedly alters stored credit card expiration dates when users travel across time zones or at random intervals. Apple Community forum posts dating back to 2017 show that the Autofill feature occasionally decrements the expiration month by one, leading to failed transactions.

stories.headline: Nigeria’s Central Bank wants every crypto P2P payment linked to a bank transaction
stories.summary: Nigeria’s Central Bank has introduced a new framework requiring cryptocurrency peer-to-peer platforms to link every digital asset transaction directly to corresponding bank payments. Additionally, the regulations mandate that stablecoin issuers build smart contract capabilities to freeze wallets, destroy tokens, and block transactions when required.
